title: Goldman doubles down on bullish Korea call after AI-stock rout
excerpt: Goldman Sachs says Korea's AI-stock rout has left market positioning much cleaner, reinforcing its bullish Kospi call.
content_html:
Goldman says Korea's AI-stock selloff has gone too far, doubles down on bull case

By Huileng Tan

You're currently following this author! Want to unfollow? Unsubscribe via the link in your email.

South Korea's stock-market selloff has gone too far, Goldman Sachs said, doubling down on its bullish call for the country's equities despite weeks of violent market swings.

On Wednesday, the country's benchmark Kospi index closed 4% higher. Index heavyweights Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix ended the day 3% and 6% higher, respectively.

Goldman reiterated its overweight rating on Korean equities and its 12-month Kospi target of 12,000 in a Tuesday note. The target implies about 80% upside from current levels.

The bank's conviction rests largely on the outlook for memory chips.

"Our central case is that the memory cycle is likely to be stronger and last longer than previous ones and that current market pricing does not reflect this prospect," Goldman's analysts wrote.

Accelerating demand for AI computing and severe memory shortages, potentially lasting through 2030, should support chip prices and profits for longer than investors expect, they wrote.

The Kospi's wild swings matter beyond South Korea because the benchmark has become an increasingly important gauge of the AI trade, with moves in Samsung and SK Hynix rippling through chip stocks across Asia and on Wall Street.

Concerns over Big Tech's capital spending, its ability to finance that investment, and intensifying competition are valid, the analysts said. But they do not overturn Goldman's view that the current AI-hardware cycle will be unusually large and long.

The recent sell-off suggests investors are underestimating how long strong profit growth can continue for Korean memory-chip makers, according to Goldman.

Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix together account for about half of the Kospi, making their outlook central to the broader market. Goldman also sees opportunities beyond memory chips, including companies in power infrastructure, industrial automation, defense, shipbuilding, robotics, and energy.

Goldman's call follows a historic boom-and-bust. The Kospi more than doubled in the first half of the year before plunging 22% in July, one of its steepest monthly declines on record.

The speed and scale of the decline were comparable with some of the market's sharpest corrections over the past two decades, including those following the 2021 tech boom, the Covid outbreak, and the dot-com bust in the early 2000s, Goldman noted.

The leverage unwind

The roller-coaster ride has also become a cultural phenomenon in South Korea.

Young investors have posted screenshots of battered portfolios, dancing videos, and jokes about surviving on instant ramen as they use humor to cope with heavy losses. Some had invested with borrowed money during the AI-fueled rally.

The tumult was partly driven by leveraged exchange-traded funds, which amplified the market's decline through technical selling.

Assets in Korean leveraged ETFs have fallen 54% from a June peak of $53 billion to $25 billion, while retail margin-loan balances have dropped from $25 billion to $19 billion, according to Goldman's analysis.

With retail investors reducing borrowed positions, regulators tightening rules on leveraged products, and hedge funds cutting their exposure, market positioning is now "much cleaner," the bank's analysts wrote.

"The market is pricing a more negative fundamental outlook than warranted and expect it to stabilize and resume its upward trend as positioning clears and newsflow corroborates the earnings outlook." Goldman analysts wrote.

content_html_zh:
高盛称韩国人工智能股抛售过度，看好牛市而加倍下注

作者：Huileng Tan 您目前正在关注该作者！ 想要取消关注吗？ 通过电子邮件中的链接取消订阅。

高盛表示，韩国股市的抛售已经太过严重，尽管市场经历了数周的剧烈波动，但仍加倍看好该国股市。

周三，该国基准 Kospi 指数收盘上涨 4%。 指数权重股三星电子和 SK 海力士当天收盘分别上涨 3% 和 6%。

高盛在周二的报告中重申了对韩国股市的增持评级以及 12 个月综合股价指数 12,000 点的目标。 该目标意味着较当前水平有约 80% 的上涨空间。

该银行的信念很大程度上取决于存储芯片的前景。

高盛分析师写道：“我们的核心观点是，内存周期可能比以前更强、持续时间更长，而当前的市场定价并未反映这一前景。”

他们写道，人工智能计算需求的加速增长和严重的内存短缺可能会持续到 2030 年，这应该会比投资者预期的更长时间支撑芯片价格和利润。

综合股价指数的大幅波动对韩国以外的地区也很重要，因为该基准已成为衡量人工智能行业日益重要的指标，三星和 SK 海力士的走势波及整个亚洲和华尔街的芯片股。

分析师表示，对大型科技公司的资本支出、投资融资能力以及竞争加剧的担忧是合理的。 但它们并没有推翻高盛的观点，即当前的人工智能硬件周期将异常大和长。

高盛表示，最近的抛售表明投资者低估了韩国存储芯片制造商的强劲利润增长能持续多久。

三星电子和 SK 海力士合计占 Kospi 指数的一半左右，这使得它们的前景成为更广泛市场的核心。 高盛还看到了内存芯片以外的机会，包括电力基础设施、工业自动化、国防、造船、机器人和能源领域的公司。

高盛的呼吁是在历史性的繁荣与萧条之后做出的。 韩国综合股价指数 (Kospi) 在今年上半年上涨了一倍多，然后在 7 月份暴跌 22%，这是有记录以来最大幅度的月度跌幅之一。

高盛指出，下跌的速度和规模与过去二十年来一些市场最剧烈的调整相当，包括2021年科技繁荣、新冠疫情爆发和2000年代初期互联网泡沫破灭之后的调整。

杠杆解除

乘坐过山车也已成为韩国的一种文化现象。

年轻投资者发布了遭受重创的投资组合的屏幕截图、跳舞视频以及靠方便面生存的笑话，因为他们用幽默来应对重大损失。 在人工智能推动的反弹期间，一些人用借来的钱进行了投资。

此次动荡的部分原因是杠杆交易所交易基金，该基金通过技术性抛售放大了市场的跌势。

高盛的分析显示，韩国杠杆 ETF 的资产已从 6 月份峰值的 530 亿美元下降 54% 至 250 亿美元，而零售保证金贷款余额从 250 亿美元下降至 190 亿美元。

该银行分析师写道，随着散户投资者减少借入头寸、监管机构收紧对杠杆产品的规定以及对冲基金削减风险敞口，市场定位现在“更加清晰”。

“市场对基本面前景的定价比合理的更加负面，并预计随着仓位的明确和消息流证实盈利前景，市场将企稳并恢复上升趋势。” 高盛分析师写道。
